findings.evidence: Lines 69–72 apply `TopologicalAbelianization.lift (continuousLocalCyclotomicCharacter p K)` only inside a proof, while `artinMap` has codomain `Field.absoluteGaloisGroupAbelianization K` (Local/ArtinMap.lean:108–113); the new results therefore require `σ`, `τ`, and quotient-equality hypotheses at Local/Cyclotomic.lean:191–194 and :235–242.
findings.fix: Expose a named continuous homomorphism on the abelianization using `TopologicalAbelianization.lift`, add its `[simp]` evaluation-on-classes lemma, and state the Artin-map results through that map rather than representatives.
findings.issue: Only `localCyclotomicCharacter_eq_of_mk_eq` is exposed, although the proof constructs the canonical factor through `Field.absoluteGaloisGroupAbelianization`; consequently the theorems at Local/Cyclotomic.lean:191 and :235 cannot state the intended character equations directly on `artinMap`.

summary: The cyclotomic character's canonical map on the abelianization is missing, forcing the new Artin-map API to quantify over arbitrary representatives.
